title: Session naming — edit the name directly

steps.path: Resume Session → click a session name
steps.headline: Click the dotted-underlined name to edit it.
steps.changed: The pencil matches the size, muted color and outline style of the tag and complete icons. The entire name opens the existing rename dialog.
steps.notice: Click the name, or focus it and press Enter or Space. Editing does not open resume controls. Your other approved changes stay unchanged.
steps.risk: Checked in the isolated preview; durable naming storage is not connected.
